tex_content.html:
For every component $C$ of $X_J$, the exponential map embeds $S_C(B)$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch It is a local diffeomorphism and each radial geodesic is embedded by Lemma 6. If two nearby radials met, Gauss–Bonnet would bound their crossing angle by $\mu +\delta $ and force all intermediate radials to meet one fixed radial, contradicting its embeddedness.

□

\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Focusing triangles contain components of J minus XJ and admit limits]
